liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Candyman** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Candyman as the highlight worth hearing the tape for [18]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat into Rider is called killer by this reviewer [18]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Ship of Fools is singled out as a standout [18]
- **Dear Mr. Fantasy** (1 other source): A 2.6-second soundboard cut near 21 seconds in was patched with audience material [2]
- **Hey Jude** (1 review): Brent's playing on Hey Jude is praised as tearing it up [21]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' is described as fully living up to its name, energetic and tight [21]
- **Just A Little Light** (1 review): Reviewer's only specific memory of the night is Just A Little Light [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-04-01.mtx.hansokolow.97203.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 166 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1990-04-01.matrix.sirmick.35168.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 164 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1990-04-01.158174.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 22 songs; 162 min [4]
- **gd90-04-01.aud.gardner.3458.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 170 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience tape has decent levels, clear strong vocals, and captures an energized crowd [23]
- **gd90-04-01.sbd.gorinsky.8512.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 4.4/5 by 15 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer found this the best-sounding source of the three-night Atlanta run among tapes they'd tracked down [21]

## Around the show

- Reviewer, at only their second Dead show, wandered the Omni lost until Rex Foundation volunteers helped find the seat [17]
- Seat numbers for the reviewer's section were on the right-hand wall, which they missed while circling the arena [17]
- Reviewer attended with Uncle John, but the many Omni shows blur together in memory [19]
- Reviewer says the tour ended in Atlanta, with only three shows in April [22]
- Many fans lacked tickets outside the Omni; reviewer eventually bought one from a scalper for $100 [25]
- Yuppies were irritated by the Deadhead parking lot scene; bumper stickers were passed around outside the CNN building [26]
- The Omni's gaping ceiling reminded the reviewer of H.R. Giger; the building was later torn down [26]
- Counterfeit tickets were everywhere at Ted Turner's Omni that night [27]
- Three songs from this night were used on the Without a Net release [22]
- Reviewer rates it better than most other Omni audience recordings they own [23]
- Spring 1990 tour found the band at its best in years, and it shows [23]
- Reviewer felt this run was less relaxed than the previous year's [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-04-01.mtx.hansokolow.97203.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of SBD: shnid=87809 and AUD: shnid=3458 by hansokolow using ProTools [1]
- **gd1990-04-01.matrix.sirmick.35168.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SirMick; source: Matrix by Sir Mick [2]. Also: Matrix combines a 24-track soundboard mixdown with an audience recording made using Nakamichi 300/CP4 and Sennheiser 441 microphones; Audience source ran about 1.35% slow and was speed-corrected; soundboard speed was assumed correct [2]
- **gd1990-04-01.158174.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 18, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [4]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several masters were used to complete the show [4]
- **gd90-04-01.aud.gardner.3458.sbeok.shnf**: source: aud MC> DAT> CD-R [5]
- **gd90-04-01.sbd.gorinsky.8512.sbeok.shnf**: source: 24 track SBD MR>Healy 2 track Mixdown>C>DAT>CDR [8]

facts.lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
facts.source: 2 Nakamichi CM300s/ CP4's  w/1 Nakamichi CM300/CP2> Nakamichi 550 w/Maxell XLIIS90 cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes. OTS 8 foot stand (sec. 128 Row DD Seat 3)
